indicator_name: Freight transport tariff index, all modes, by region, monthly
description: Индекс тарифов на перевозку грузов всеми видами транспорта по регионам, помесячно
unit: % (previous month = 100 or same month a year earlier = 100)
methodology: Taldau 703062, period 4. BNS changed the index's dimensions in 2026: 2011-01 … 2025-12 under 67,490,848,2533,3029, 2026-01 on under 68,490,848,3029; both are read and stitched (the later segment wins on a common month). National 2025-12: YOY 104.6; 2026-09: MOM 98.9. Rail is confidential; by mode of transport only in the monthly bulletin (name=19105).
